// @autogenerated
Uid* (string)::
Unique identifier of the rule.
Name* (string)::
Name of the rule.
Origin (xref:#entidad-observed-source[ObservedSource])::
Origin it applies to; empty for every origin.
Field* (ObservedFingerprintRuleFieldOptions)::
Field the pattern is checked against: the message, the exception type or each stack frame.Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * message
 * type
 * frame

Pattern* (string)::
Regular expression (Java syntax, at most 200 characters; an expression that takes too long is ignored).
Effect* (ObservedFingerprintRuleEffectOptions)::
group-as: one issue for every matching event. ignore-frame: the matching frames do not count in the fingerprint. drop: no issue (the logs stay).Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * group-as
 * ignore-frame
 * drop

Group key (string)::
For group-as: name of the group (the events of every rule with the same key go together); empty: the rule itself.
Enabled* (boolean)::
A disabled rule is not applied.
Version (integer)::
Campo con el número de version de observed fingerprint rule para controlar bloqueos optimistas
